acceptance_evidence: AC1, both installers succeed: graphify claude install wrote its CLAUDE.md section and the PreToolUse hooks, graphify install --platform codex wrote the skill to ~/.codex/skills/graphify, and graphify affected "evaluate" answers about this repository. Recorded at records 2 and 8

AC2, the hook rebuilds the graph: graphify hook status reports post-commit, post-checkout and the merge driver installed, and the commit of harness/graph.py triggered a rebuild from 371 to 382 nodes. The graph lands with the following commit, and the criterion is re-worded to say so

AC3, the MCP server exposes the four tools and the graph answers for the stage gate: tools/list returned query_graph, get_neighbors, shortest_path and get_pr_impact among ten, and graphify affected "evaluate" returns advance() and execute() as its callers
AC4, CI runs the code-only extraction: the graph job installs graphifyy, extracts, asserts the graph parses and is not empty, and uploads GRAPH_REPORT.md as an artefact
AC5, harness graph writes into the journal: record 8 carries the mode, the command, the exit code, the answer and the sha256 of the graph that answered

findings.claim: The reviewed-tree fingerprint counted graphify-out, which the post-commit hook rewrites in the background after every commit
findings.failure_scenario: Any ticket worked with the hook installed: review attests a fingerprint, the delivery commit fires the hook, the hook rewrites graph.json, and verify-delivery refuses the delivery for a change no person made. Every ticket from here on would have failed at its last step
findings.resolution: Returned the ticket to tdd at record 11, added the graph directory to FINGERPRINT_EXCLUDED with a red at 12 and a green at 13, and corrected the test that had asserted the opposite

findings.claim: graphify claude install wrote an absolute path from this machine into the PreToolUse hooks
findings.failure_scenario: A second machine or CI checks the repository out, the hook command /Users/ruudvanengelenhoven/.local/bin/graphify does not exist, and every Bash, Grep, Read and Glob call pays a failing hook
findings.resolution: Rewritten to resolve graphify from PATH before the file was committed

findings.claim: graphify-mcp could not start: the uv tool venv had no mcp module, so the MCP server the ticket requires would have failed on first use
findings.failure_scenario: A session opens Claude Code expecting query_graph, the server exits with ModuleNotFoundError, and the session silently falls back to reading files, which is the behaviour the graph exists to replace
findings.resolution: Reinstalled with uv tool install graphifyy --with mcp, then verified over stdio that tools/list returns the four tools the ticket names

findings.claim: core.hooksPath still pointed at .githooks from the deleted project, a directory that no longer exists, so no git hook would have run at all
findings.failure_scenario: graphify hook install reports success, writes to .git/hooks, and nothing ever runs, so the graph silently goes stale while everyone believes it is current
findings.resolution: Unset core.hooksPath so git uses .git/hooks, then confirmed with graphify hook status and a real commit that triggered a rebuild

findings.claim: The committed graph covers only the 36 code files; the 103 documents that are most of this repository are not in it
findings.failure_scenario: A session asks the graph about the PRD or the architecture and gets nothing, then falls back to reading files, which is the cost the graph was meant to remove
findings.resolution: Accepted deliberately for this ticket: the semantic pass needs an LLM backend, and the decision at clarify was that CI stays deterministic and the docs pass is run on purpose. Raised to the founder as an optional follow-up rather than left silent

security_checklist: No secret in the diff: the MCP server takes no key, and CI's extraction is code-only with no API key
No new dependency in the monorepo: graphifyy is a uv tool outside the repository
No live marketplace call in any test: the graph tests run against a stub graphify on PATH
No PII: the graph holds symbol names and file paths from this repository only
The PreToolUse hooks graphify installed were read before being committed, and their absolute path removed
